# Tone of voice

Options on every market, every hour.

Strike is an options exchange that never closes. About 80 underlyings: stocks, indices, pre-IPO companies, GPU compute and crypto. Open 168 hours a week, against about 32.5 for listed options.

No key at Strike can move your funds. What is still trusted is documented: settlement prints, prices on market orders, liquidation prices and the attesters, run by Strike today.

Never write "24/7", "revolutionary" or "safe" in copy. The color is Strike Green, centered in the layout.

Options involve risk. Closed beta, invite required.
